summarize_tensor: summarize a torch tensor by printing its shape, first and last values, and sum in llama.cpp debug format
save_output_data: save model output data, tokens, and prompt to binary and text files in a specified output directory
compare_tokens: compare token arrays from two model outputs and report mismatches with position details
setup_rope_debug: monkey-patch a transformer model's RoPE function to log input and output tensor activations for debugging
exit_with_warning: exit with a message and print a transformers version mismatch warning if the model config requires a different version
